servux.config.litematic_data.analyze_con: Also tally the contents of every container in the area, including shulker boxes and bundles nested inside them. §aThis is the main reason to analyse on the server§r: a client is never told the contents of a container it has not opened, so its own analysis reports every chest as empty. Reading them all is also the expensive part, hence the switch
servux.config.litematic_data.analyze_max: The largest area, in blocks, a single analysis may cover. An analysis reads every position in the area, so an unbounded selection is an unbounded amount of work. Set to 0 to lift the cap
servux.config.litematic_data.chunk_walk_: Load chunks that a verification, area analysis or material list needs but that are not in memory. Loading is non-blocking and the chunks are loaded but not ticked, so no mobs spawn and no redstone runs in them. Disable to only read what happens to be loaded already

Generate terrain for chunks a verification, area analysis or material list covers that have never been generated. §6Off by default: this permanently enlarges the world as a side effect of merely inspecting it, and world gen is far too slow to fit the per-tick budget§r. When off, such chunks are reported as ungenerated instead

How many new chunk loads a verification, area analysis or material list may start per tick. They all pull chunks in through the same loader, so they share this budget. Lower values make them slower but gentler on disk I/O
Chunk Walk Max Loads Per Tick
Stop starting new chunk loads while the average tick time is above this many milliseconds. Chunks already in memory keep being read. Set to 0 to never back off
servux.config.litematic_data.deduplicate: Enable entity De-Duplication based on an entity ID and/or UUID
servux.config.litematic_data.fix_chest_m: Enable / Disable the fixing of Chest Mirroring when Chests are Mirrored.
servux.config.litematic_data.fix_rail_ro: Enable / Disable the fixing of Rail Rotations when Rails are rotated 180 degrees.
servux.config.litematic_data.fix_stairs_: Enable / Disable the fixing of Stair Mirroring when Stairs are Mirrored.
servux.config.litematic_data.permission_: The permission level required for the Litematics data provider
The permission level required for the Litematics server side area analyze operation
The permission level required for the Litematics server side material list operation
The permission level required for the Litematics paste operation
The permission level required for the Litematics task requests
The permission level required for the Litematics server side verify operation
servux.config.litematic_data.player_task: Enable / Disable Servux sending the players Litematic task feedback messages
servux.config.litematic_data.task_batch_: How many entries to put in each result batch sent to a client: mismatch positions for a verification, and block states, entity types and items for an area analysis or material list. The client acknowledges each batch before the next is produced, so a large result crosses the wire a bounded amount at a time
servux.config.litematic_data.task_sessio: How long in seconds a verification, area analysis or material list may sit idle - for example a result the client never collects - before it is cancelled and discarded. Set to 0 to disable the timeout
servux.config.litematic_data.verify_max_: The maximum number of mismatch positions a single verification will keep. Category totals stay accurate past this point, but the position lists stop growing and the result is flagged as truncated. Set to 0 to keep counts only
Also compare the contents of containers, reported as the 'Wrong Contents' category. Only checked where the block state already matches, so this count overlaps the correct-state count rather than adding to the other mismatch categories
servux.config.litematic_data.verify_nbt_: How many Wrong Contents positions a verification also sends both containers' contents for, so that Litematica can show the schematic's and the world's inventory side by side. Container data can be large, so this is capped separately. Set to 0 to send positions only

Compare container contents slot by slot instead of as an unordered multiset. §6Off by default because slot order is rarely meaningful§r, and a mirrored placement swaps the halves of every double chest
Also compare item data components (enchantments, custom names, and so on) rather than just the item id and count
servux.config.litematic_data.verify_sync: Enable / Disable reading Syncmatica's shared placements from disk, so that '/servux verify' can verify them without an upload
